title: Abyssal Prism

effect.label: Effect
effect.value: The first time each turn you target a friendly unit with a spell, non-move effects also hit all other friendly units on the floor.

flavor.label: Flavor Text
flavor.value: When I look into the Pyre, I see the monster I have become. Perhaps, if I was to remove my Titanhood from my body, this nightmare might end.

tables: Fixed Abyssal Prism incorrectly applying attack from each teammate instead of just the front unit when Cleave is cast. Fixed Abyssal Prism incorrectly scaling X Cost effects on friendly units. Fixed Abyssal Prism targeting units with Stasis .

Fixed an issue where Abyssal Prism + Weaponized Prosthetic did not apply the attack bonus to the non-primary target if other units on the same floor also had equipment removed. Changed Abyssal Prism to only work with cards that directly target a unit. Fixed Magnetic Relay when recast by Abyssal Prism incorrectly returning Champion units to the player's hand.
summary: Abyssal Prism is a Clanless Artifact . It causes the first spell you play each turn targeting a friendly unit to affect all friendly units on the floor, barring movement effects.

title: Death's Dancer

flavor.label: Flavor Text
flavor.value: "Dance is a poem in which each kill is a step."

tables: Frenzystone grants Multistrike , which can allow Death's Dancer to become your primary damage dealer when duplicated sufficiently. With three Death's Dancers with Frenzystone , each Shift trigger will add 72 to the floor in total, and this increases the more copies you can fit. If this seems likely to be your strategy, Speedstone makes up for the unit's low , but it should not be a priority otherwise.
Smidgestone reduces the unit's size, making it easier to fit many copies on the floor in the absence of Ascend and Descend effects.
Heartstone makes Death's Dancer less fragile.

Discarded Wings grants the Flight ability along with a small stat boost, which is highly useful for Death's Dancer . Archus' Wing is identical, but provides slightly more stats; those extra stats are usually not worth the risk of losing the wings entirely, however. Wings of Light is usually a downgrade, mostly because the Flying Strike ability has Cooldown 4 instead of Cooldown 2 .
